notes.title: The labyrinth in the castle is a must-have
notes.content:
Doors leading to different parts of the labyrinth.
You also need to create a control center for the labyrinth - apparently for the villain. So that he can reconfigure which doors go where.

notes.title: ✨🎮 It wasn’t easy 🔮
notes.content:
✨🎮 It wasn’t easy 🔮
But now you can find spells  just like weapons! ⚔️
Equip them to the right wing 🦢
🔥 — for now, it’s just a fire spell and telekinesis, but everything works! 💥🌀
Solid blocks in place for future development!
